item.description:

get_random_bitmask_list

Expand all   Collapse all

Creates a list of random bitmasks.

def get_random_bitmask_list(count: Int, range_start: Int = Int(0), range_end: Int = Int(1000), out list: List[_BitMask[Int(256)]])

Args:

  • count (Int): The number of bitmasks to create.
  • range_start (Int): The inclusive lower bound for the generated Int.
  • range_end (Int): The exclusive upper bound for the generated Int.
  • list (List[_BitMask[Int(256)]])

Returns:

List[_BitMask[Int(256)]]: The generated list of bitmasks. Result is undefined if either condition is violated:

  • count must be non-negative.
  • range_start must be non-negative.
  • range_end must be at most 2^64.
  • range_start must be less than range_end.

item.title: test_copy_move_del
item.description:
Development reference · Larecs 1.0.0b1 · revision 24a607075a78. Host threading and device execution are experimental. Compatibility and status.

Mojo functionSource

test_copy_move_del

Expand all   Collapse all

Test the copy, move, and delete operations of a container.

def test_copy_move_del[Container: Copyable & Deinitable, //, container_factory: def(var val: MemTestStruct[MutUnsafeAnyOrigin, MutUnsafeAnyOrigin, MutUnsafeAnyOrigin]) thin -> Container](*, init_moves: Int = Int(0), copy_moves: Int = Int(0), move_moves: Int = Int(0))

The tracked value uses MutUntrackedOrigin for its counters intentionally. This keeps the produced container type fixed across call sites. The purpose of this helper is to verify lifecycle behavior, not caller-origin propagation.

Parameters:

  • Container (Copyable & Deinitable): The type of the container to test.
  • container_factory (def(var val: MemTestStruct[MutUnsafeAnyOrigin, MutUnsafeAnyOrigin, MutUnsafeAnyOrigin]) thin -> Container): A function that creates a container from a MemTestStruct.

Args:

  • init_moves (Int): The expected number of element move operations during initialization.
  • copy_moves (Int): The expected number of element move operations during copying.
  • move_moves (Int): The expected number of element move operations during moving.

Raises:

AssertionError: If any copy, move, or delete count differs from the expected value.
